system.description: You sing the first line of the dirge backwards, and the dead claw up through cobble, silt and soot. Test Sanity (DR12). On a success, two thralls rise in empty spaces within 30' of you, or one that you may command at once as part of this power.

outcomes.triumph: Three thralls rise, or two and you may command one at once.
outcomes.failure: One thrall rises, but it cannot act until your next turn.
outcomes.ruin: One thrall rises wrong: it attacks the nearest living creature (d4), then collapses.
